name: Affix | 6pk CBD Patches | Comfort
description: Meet the achy body "I need relief" patch with an all-natural formula. Just peel and place a ComfortFIX™ patch on or near your area of discomfort and allow 35mg of premium Hemp, Menthol, Wintergreen Oil and Vitamin E work it's magic and add comfort to your day. Ideal for: Body Aches Sore Muscles Hangovers Stiffness Discomfort Affix Hemp patches use transdermal technology to deliver through the skin. Our Hemp patch formula is all-natural, safe, non-habit-forming and contains no trace of THC or cannabis. Affix Patches provide consistent delivery over a 24 hour period. You can remove whenever you like. By adding Menthol, Wintergreen Oil Extract and Vitamin E to our all-natural ComfortFIX Hemp formula, this patch targets localized pain relief.
